company_info.company_description: "At Velocity Solar, we understand that investing in solar energy is a long-term commitment, and we want to make sure that your investment brings you the maximum benefits and peace of mind.With our “do it once and do it right” approach, you can trust that your solar system will be designed, installed, and maintained with utmost care and expertise."

abn_details.abn_company_name: The Trustee For B & M Ott Family Trust

reviews.review_description: I had done a lot of homework as I really wanted this system to put us in the box seat going into the future like our 15 yo system did all those years ago. I had three quote at my home from solar quotes suggested companies. One other company had a good (lower) quote with cheaper materials but I am particularly wary of quality. The second company rep didn't really listen to what I was saying and was really surprised when i had a sp;id reason for not wanting their help. I had a winning quote with Electrify Victoria (Sophie listened carefully and acknowledged what she was hearing adding details that clarified what I understood about the possibilities). They were a little more expensive but all the equipment they suggested was top order. Unfortunately Sophie is stepping sideways into chargers and I just happened along when they were in the change over and she decided they wouldn't be able to follow through. Fortunately, she asked if she could pass on my quote to her previous employer if he would honour it, as she said he did great work. Velocity solar came to see the site twice and confirmed they were happy to take up the quote. They offered the same guarantees and initially scheduled to do the job in February 2026. The job was for a tesla 3 and panels to update our old PFIT setup and a switchboard update. In the mean time, Finn P sent me a video of the Sigenstor system and suggested I look into whether that might be more appropriate given our requirements. Brad from Velocity solar said he was not surprised I was looking at a Sig and was happy to go forward with the change. Fortunately for us, because other Tesla jobs were delayed by govt. not giving the 3 approval yet, our job was brought forward and the team finished it across this last week (so much sooner than expected). They were friendly and careful of our time and tried to limit interruptions. They let us know when they would be on the job earlier (to avoid very hot weather) and were back on when they said they would be. They walked me through the use of the system and the the lead fitter (Hayden) is very particular (and agonised with double checking all the team's work was not only functional but neat; about getting conduits level and the warning stickers lined up straight). I can highly recommend them for their work and care. My border collie is bored and misses the guys terribly. Now to save up for a charger.
From the quoting process to the finished installation and customer support was outstanding

Only half of my system was working, have no idea how long it was out of action, fitted by another company... Have heard good reports about Velocity Solar and so sent them an email, got an estimate back by email, and said yes, their tech person came and had it sorted in a very reasonable time frame.The details of what took place were clearly explained.The final cost was very reasonable.Customer service, they had a few issues trying to get a tech to catch up with us. all good in the end.

Very impressed with the guy who came to my home and discussed my needs and expectations. The 4 guys that came to install the system were really nice efficient and cleaned up really impressed with how easy and smooth the whole process was

Venergy were very good at quoting and following up to ensure we got the quote for exactly what we wanted.The installation team was very polite and communicated well during the installation.Follow up after installation and inspection and connection went very well and quickly,We would recommend Venergy again

Good company and a very smooth experience from negotiation to installation, I was pleased to learn I could get brand new high-efficiency Trina Solar Vertex S panels. Sales were very knowledgeable and answered every question I had with the process very transparent and guided. The system is solid and generates nicely, though I had a minor problem with the install. I raised this with Venergy and they sent a guy to fix it within a week which spoke very well for their integrity and quality. Would recommend.

Velocity Solar are a professional company.Sales staff where punctual and well informed, communication was first class.Installation was trouble free.Still awaiting final links to energy company but comfortable that things are in progress.

Fantastic quoting process, Luke was happy to help with about 7 variations of the system before we finally decided.The team did a great job installing it, the work was very tidy. Awesome happy bunch too, and it was great to see they are all employees and not subbies.All communications from their office were great throughout the process. A great local Geelong company. Highly recommended.We had quotes from other suppliers, and Velocity were head and shoulders above the others. One turned up and never followed up with a quote, another refused to come out to see our site (they had a good price but cheap gear), and I got a really bad vibe from the last one.So happy we chose Velocity in the end.

Brad from Velocity Solar was the only reseller who made a site visit to understand our site in detail and could accurately explain how a Tesla battery works on 3 phase.The installer crew were fantastic, and they all took off their boots and cleaned them before walking on our deck or roof!

We've had a really great experience with Velocity so far. The quote was thoroughly explained and felt comfortable asking lots of questions. They provided the best design for our not so easy roof that would allow for max capture of the days sunlight. It wasn't the cheapest but that wasn't what we were looking for. The install was done really efficiently with minimal interruption to us and the guys were friendly and knowledgeable.
We found the whole Solar Velocity team to be extremely helpful, efficient and very pleasant to deal with from the initial contact through to the final installation.Sue

The sales and quoting process was the best of any installer I received quotes with. Functional website and online booking system. Attended my property covered all details required and answered all my questions. Very personable sales manager.The installation I don't think could have gone much worse. Was meant to be installed in a day however took 3 days over 3 weeks. The first day wasn't the greatest weather rained on and off however they continued to work. They broke about 15 tiles. I had previously asked how many tiles I'd need to source and they stated 7 so I didn't have enough to cover all the breaks. They came back a week later and continued worked broken another 20 plus tiles. I had since sourced some replacement tiles getting another 20 to ensure I had enough (I didn't). We then had a leak in the roof which caused water damage to my ceiling. Another week later they finished the install breaking another 33 tiles. In all 60 tiles were broken in the installation of my panels.The installation team particularly the team leader for the 2nd and 3rd day was easy to deal with. Velocity paid $1100 to repaint my ceiling. They did their best with putting replacement tiles under the panels and moved broken ones near gutters in an attempt to avoid leaks. The team leader offered to come back to install more roof tiles when I sourced replacements at the end of the job. I've since had leaks and not bothered contacting Velocity about these.They organised the grid connection after install.As a side note my brother also had an install with Velocity and didn't have any broken tiles.
I was kept informed.  Installers were diligent, methodical and tidy.  Excellent.
Deposit paid, installation delayed by Covid. Constant follow up regarding installation date. Inspection was deferred, but punctual and informative when rescheduled.

Customer service was excellent from the beginning. They were able to answer all my questions & designed a system to suit my needs. Their quote for a good quality solar system was reasonable. The tradies did a great job & I am happy with the end result. I would highly recommend them to anyone looking at getting solar.
Would highly recommend this installation company, pleasant to deal with, great workmanship, easy to contact.
The whole Velocity Team were fantastic to work with. Customer service was excellent as was the workmanship and attention to detail.

We have had solar systems at other homes in the past, this system is generating more than any other we have ever had. Venergy gave us a great deal and instructed us on how to apply for the rebates they were very professional every step of the way. The installers were punctual, and professional also, spending time to explain our system in detail. Our property was left clean and tidy. We received follow up call calls and emails after installation. I would not hesitate in recommending Venergy to any of my family or friends.

Velocity provided good service and value for money. They were open to discus/make changes to the original design. Any queries were promptly answered. The whole process went smoothly. They managed all the  paperwork for the installation, including that for connection to the grid. The installation and commissioning, went smoothly. Installers arrived at the time designated. The installations appears to be of a high standard. Power is flowing.

Velocity was supportive and attentive. Brad worked to help us before we even build our home. They were always trying to make things easier. They are highly professional and, like our neighbours, we would highly recommend them. They also support apprentices - but your work will be overseen and checked by A-grade electricians. Our systems is performing very well. Installation went smoothly despite our strong winds. Unlike some installers who try and push you to their way of thinking, Velocity has the patience to work through the challenges with you. If you are finding the choices and information overwhelming or want to be sure of excellent results then we recommend them. They only use the proven best equipment. Their followup has been excellent.

The sales people really know the job, not pushy, price and quality excellent, a real credit to the solar industry. The installers were great to ,great guys really new there job n polite, turned up for the job on time, explained to me about  the install, very helpful, very good trade people left the work area spotless and organised the grid connection, service  faultless, aaa1 service from start to finish, highly recommend this  company, great work, very happy, thank you to all the team.

We had been thinking of installing solar panels for a little while, when we saw Venergy's placard outside a house in a neighbouring street. We talked to the owner of the house who gave a glowing reference.We then called Venergy and started conversations with Karim, who was very patient and explained the whole process very clearly. He recommended high quality panels, inverter and racking. We also got quotes from a few other companies. When we compared their quotes with Venergy quote, we felt Venergy quote to be better quality and better value.The installation was delayed due to COVID but that is no fault of the installer. Installation team is highly capable and led by Michael who was very good at communicating and explaining the day’s work. He showed us his solar panel installer registration before he started the work which gave us confidence that we were dealing with experienced professionals. The only improvement I would suggest is that it would have been better if a proper installation diagram had been provided after the first site visit.Special thanks to James acting as End-To-End Delivery Co-ordinator who ensured that the post installation tasks were carried out in a prompt and efficient manner. We are currently waiting for the connection to the grid from the electricity generator/distributor which hopefully will come through very soonI would strongly recommend Venergy to anyone interested in installing Solar. In fact I have recommended to my friends.

We had been thinking of installing solar panels for a little while, when we saw VENERGY’S placard outside a house in a neighbouring street. We talked to the owner of the house who gave a glowing reference.We then called VENERGY and started conversations with Karim, who was very patient and explained the whole process very clearly. He recommended high quality panels, inverter and racking. We also got quotes from a few other companies. When we compared their quotes with VENERGY quote, we felt VENERGY quote to be better quality and better value.The installation was delayed due to COVID but that is no fault of the installer. Installation team is highly capable and led by Michael who was very good at communicating and explaining the day’s work. He showed us his solar panel installer registration before he started the work which gave us confidence that we were dealing with experienced professionals. The only improvement I would suggest is that it would have been better if a proper installation diagram had been provided after the first site visit.Special thanks to James acting as End-To-End Delivery Co-ordinator who ensured that the post installation tasks were carried out in a prompt and efficient manner. We are currently waiting for the connection to the grid from the electricity generator/distributor which hopefully will come through very soonI would strongly recommend VENERGY to anyone interested in installing Solar.

The process was seamless all online, I was let know up to date information related to COVID restrictions and next possible installation schedule.Good communicationExcellent installation quality.Top brand solar panels and inverters generating electricity efficiently even on cloudy days.
Gr8 bunch of ppl. Good products. Good service and did a lot of the hard yards for us.

Quote was done on-site during our house build and whilst not 100% accurate regarding the final layout due to no roof access it was good enough to quote the price for our 20 panels for our 6.6kW System. It came up a bit more expensive than other quotes but for much better quality panels/inverter. We felt it was a much better quality/price option whilst also giving the work to a local installer.Very helpful staff over the phone and by email. Got it installed within 3 months of original quote.Installation done efficiently in one day althought on-site leader lacked serious customer service skills and was not very helpful at all in offering proper solutions to encountered problems. It felt like he just wanted the job done and move on to the next one.Aside from that the job was done properly and the after install support was very good with grid connection going smoothly in a timely manner.
System getting fitted Oct 20, depending on Covid restrictions  great customer service  & contact. Company recommended to us
Velocity solar were professional and efficient in the installation of our system. A great job by Travers and his guys.

The sales and quoting process was very detailed and thorough. We had a lot of questions which were all answered very professionally and promptly. The sales person that reviewed our house initially was very knowledgeable and not at all push wish we really liked. They talked us through the rebate process and explained everything in detail.The team that came to install the system were also extremely professional and had excellent communication. They were efficient and tidy.The ongoing customer service has been great with prompt relies and have facilitated our connection to the grid.

Velocity contacted me immediately upon inquiry, provided great advice about applying for the rebates and scheduled installation promptly.  The system is up and running and will be connected to the grid shortly.

We did extensive research into solar systems and installers and after aproaching four companies, we decided on Velocity Solar. They were all professional and prompt, and delivered high-quality products and service. Brad Ott (owner), Nicole (office and admin) and Trav (installer) were all exceptional. They installed a 6.3 kW system (REC panels) on a 5 kW Fronius inverter, split between east and west-facing arrays. I monitor our performance regularly (methods on SolarQuotes) and know that weâ€™re running at ~90% of predicted maximumâ€¦ confident the system from Velocity Solar is performing really well. I highly recommend this group.

The whole process from start to finish has been handled efficiently and with our interests foremost by both sales and installation team from Velocity Solar. This included assistance in applying for the Victorian solar panel rebate and a willingness to fully answer and find out the details in response to the numerous questions we asked. While our system has only become operational in the last three days (installation slightly delayed by inclement weather), we have nothing but praise for the whole team at Velocity Solar, whose politeness and willingness to help and to explain the technical and other aspects of our system has been exemplary. At this early point in time we have been completely satisfied with the performance of the system.We have also been very grateful to Solar Quotes for the comprehensive information available on the website, the reviews of equipment and installers, and the very good advice given
Being installed next Thursday and Friday. 12kw sun solar with 2 fronius inverters
I can truly recommend Velocity Solar as a quality installer. From the first sales meeting to the final install meeting we were very impressed with their professionalism. Well done Velocity Solar.

Velocity Solar installed a high quality PV system to our house at a competitive price and so far we cannot fault it. From the beginning Brad and Paul were honest, the communication was great and were able to answer all of our questions. The installation process with Velocity Solar was trouble free with the guys turning up on the day as promised, were polite and cheery and the workmanship was great. The tiles were trimmed neatly, the Radiant racking system was of top quality, trimmed off against the panels so there was no ugly overhang and no shortcuts were taken even when the guys discovered the steel frame trusses in our roof were at a greater spacing thus requiring additional brackets to be sent from an hour away. The invertor was installed in the garage, the meter was rewired to make it safer, safety stickers were installed, all wiring was concealed with none visible from the outside and protective covers were installed over isolator switches.We received an information pack of the system, were stepped through the emergency shut down and maintenance procedures and a guide of the process in the coming weeks in relation to Powercor inspections, certificates, energy retailers and feed-in tarrifs. Velocity Solar's princing also offers us a 12 month follow up inspection, system performance check and panel clean. I would highly recommend Velocity Solar for your PV system.
We haven't had it installed yet, so can't really comment fully.

Equipment was only installed last Thursday (21st June) so no knowledge of any operable benefits yet, but was pleased with the credibility of the people at Velocity Solar, and the better appearance of the completed installation compared with a close neighbour (a different supplier). Am looking forward to the finalisation of the link with Powercor through my retailer (Origin), and the subsequent improvement in my power bills.

Still waiting to schedule in the install date â€“ but so far we are happy, we have purchased a high quality 5kw system for around $6.5K when the "door knockers" who represented the bulk-buy scheme had quoted us $12K for a lesser quality system.Overall very happy we used your service and not the "door-knockers"...!!!Anthony, Jan Juc

Velocity Solar offers quality PV systems that are installed to a high standard at a competitive price Communication was great, once the install date was planned they arrived on time and on the date promised. Brad, Travers and Denise were all great to deal with, replying to emails and answering any questions I had. Once the install was complete, I received an information pack with all the details about the system installed, maintenance and a guide as to what happens in the following weeks regarding Feed-In/Powercor/My Energy Retailer. The quality of the install was to a high standard with great workmanship.I would highly recommend to anyone else seeking a quality PV system.

We went with Velocity Solar because we wanted to use a local supplier.  Unfortunately you did have any suppliers on your list from Geelong.  You provide a great service though.  Really happy with our experience with you.
The only stumbling block was the Vic Gov. They got buried by the uptake applications for the rebate They were just not prepared for the number of people applying.

Fantastic team for installation. Started at 8 am and gone by 2.30 pm! They worked really well and were very cheerful and polite.The inspection took a while to come through. And itâ€™s been a month and Iâ€™m still waiting for my energy retailer to get the paper work sorted. That means Iâ€™m still not getting paid for all the electricity being generated and going back into the grid.Thanks Finn and your team. Iâ€™m glad Iâ€™ve got the system up and running.

Very hard to choose between Velocity Solar and Geelong Solar.  Price was similar.  Information from both companies was great and they both answered all my questions.  Now waiting for the inspection and the interaction with the retailer companies for the best price part!

I had a really great experience with Velocity Solar. Brad and his team were very informative from start to end. I received a top quality system for a great price and I had many quotes from other solar dealers. Velocity Solar were very professional and it was a pleasure doing business with them. I highly recommend them to anyone who wants a serious solar system with great back up from their team.

Their Consultant gave me several options on different system setups and listened to my requirements, installation of the system I choose was done professionally and communication with the company  friendly and helpful.
Velocity Solar, Brad and his whole team, were just great.  From the first meeting to the follow-up post installation I simply can't fault them

Brad Ott (Owner) is a down to earth, no bull type of sales person, who lets you know exactly what can and can't be done.  He tells you he is the owner and he has a team that will install the system.  We found Brad to be very knowledgable, helpful and cost competitive.  Would recommend him.
The entire process was quick efficient and hassle free I would certainly recommend Velocity Solar to any prospective purchaser

A lot of information to sort through.   I felt the other 2 were very helpful but I didn't think their panels/inverters may have been top quality. ( after reading your website reviews)    Velocity Solar were installing the better range of panels/inverters.    I think Velocity may have been one of YOUR quotes.   Can't remember as I received 7 different quotes all up and a lot of information I had to process.   Your website contained a lot of good information.Thank You Bruce haynes

With the help of Solarquotes.com.au we felt well equipped to ask the right questions to get what was right for us. It was a tough choice in the end as we had 2 companies that were both really great in our opinion (the 3rd company 'Specialised Solar Solutions' didn't get back to us). We went with the one that had the better quality Inverter at a good price. We were very happy with the service provided, the customer service was excellent throughout the whole process and even post installation. We also appreciated that the owner of the company was part of the install and set up. We are very happy with Velocity Solar and excited to be using our solar energy now. We would highly recommend their services.

Brad Otte has given me the best customer service experience in many a long year. From sales, installation, follow up and queries, the process was flawless.Installation was done in one day!!After installation, he sat with me and explained the whole system (in my language) with much patience.Several weeks later my Internet was upgraded to  cable and the system needed to be re configured. Brad was amazingly generous with his time and did it for free. Not being IT savey this was a godsend.Would I recommend Velocity Solar to friends, relatives and anyone looking at solar installation?.....Hell Yes.Brad is one of the most personable business people i have met in a long time and I love my solar system.

If you are looking for a solar provider that talks straight and you can trust then look no further - Brad the owner of  the business was extremely honest and up front which was very much appreciated. The salesman and the installers were both friendly and professional. Thank-you to all
Both Sunrun Solar and Velocity Solar provided great levels of technical advice. It was really hard to choose between them.
Communication could have been better

Our house is being built so panels not installed yet but Brad Ott from Velocity Solar (VS) was great, as was Paul Battista who organised the 'rough-in' with the builder in a timely manner. VS also organised the placement of panels for maximum efficiency while ensuring our neighbours view was minimally impacted which all parties were grateful for!
The whole process was very easy. The installation went very smoothly and the boys were lovely. They also cleaned up very well afterwards. I would highly recommend Velocity Solar.
Brad always available and ready to answer questions.Installation went well with no hassles.very good customer relations and very ready to assist and make sure all ok.Would highly recommend.
The service and feedback that was provided was first rate . Very professional . Highly recommended .

The service that Brad Ott from Velocity Solar provided was first rate . The feedback that I received with regards to pricing , time of job completion etc was comprehensive and the professionalism of the work done could not be faulted . I don't normally write reviews but felt compelled to do so this time due to the fact that that every aspect of the job from the quote phase to final completion was excellent . I would highly recommend Brad ( Velocity Solar ) for those who are seeking peace of mind. Sincerely Bill Franks.

Brad was able to provide a service that I would expect from anyone that I purchase a product from, especially when i am spending thousands of my hard earned. Sadly this level of service appears to be poorly lacking in the building industry in general. Highly recommend Velocity Solar.

Hi Finn, Thanks for an informative service. Found this website useful even after having done my own research.Brad Ott at Velocity Solar answered all of many questions and provided a solution which best utilised my limited roof space and offset my power consumption as required during different times of the day. Delivered  an on- time installation at a great price.Well  done Finn and Brad.

Brad Ott from Velocity is fantastic to deal with. We were happy with the service he provided us with quotes and explanations and then after we decided to go with him, he was very quick to get everything organised and installed. I would highly recommend him to anyone thinking of installing solar power.

Brad from Velocity Solar was the first to quote and did the best job, going so far as to get up onto our roof to plan the installation and tell us exactly what issues might arise.  It was great to get the person actualy doing the installation to do the quote.  He was on time for every appointment, and completed the job on time and as per his quote - there were no surprises or unexpected delays or extras.  I would certainly recommend him to anyone planning a solar installation without any hesitation.
Came when he said he would, actually got on the roof to assess our needs, and was not trying to push us to buy one particular system over another but gave us options.
Barwon Solar didn't front. I didn't chase it.

Brad the owner and installer explained every thing and sold me only the system that suited my needs.They were very prompt came when they promised. The work was very well done and after service provided so far has been very good.Can recommend them to anyone.
Genuine desire on the part of the company to satisfy our needs.

Velocity Solar were excellent, Brad Ott (owner) very helpful, cheerful and efficient. Installation went smoothly. Can't comment on the efficiency of the panels or value for money  till we get out next bill.

The supplier I went with was very easy to deal with, giving quotes in person and coming over and looking at the house which the other guys did not bother who  just looked at the house over on the internet.He was well worth going with.
